items.message: All pages are run in a single mypy invocation; a failure in one page swamps the error output for others.

_page_module skips `from __future__ import annotations` lines inside blocks but keeps them in the prelude; a block relying on PEP 563 postponed evaluation at module scope may behave differently if that import is stripped.

New snippet returns `Outcome(status=Status.SUCCEEDED, value={"seconds": 0.0})` but the declared return type is `Outcome[dict[str, float]]`; this is correct, but the comment above it says 'A real adapter parses the report; the shape is what matters here' while the previous ellipsis version was clearer that the body is illustrative — minor doc clarity issue, not a type error.
